name: shipit
description: Spec-driven development for any repo. Detects your conventions instead of assuming them.

plugins.name: shipit
plugins.description: Draft tickets, plan, implement, and deliver work under a contract generated from your own repo, with a design contract agents follow for UI. Opt-in parallel worktrees, evidence-backed conventions, tracker-agnostic ticket drafting, and a handoff whose side effects are a config list you control.
